amanda: planning to cut the deploy for release/rc-2026-03-17 at 21:00 UTC (~40m). Need quick sign-offs and to confirm rollback readiness. Deploy gameplan below:

- owners: @devon (runtime), @kirby (canary), @mike (sre on-call)
- window: 21:00–21:30 UTC
- lanes: canary -> ramp -> main
- smoke: canary smoke suite, perf quick-run, migration dry-run
- rollback tag: release/rc-2026-03-17-rollback
- abort if: error rate > 2% (5m), median latency > 2s (5m), any failed smoke test

Checklist (please ack):
- [ ] canary image built and verified
- [ ] migration SQL validated on staging
- [ ] canary run smoke passed
- [ ] runbooks updated (playbook + rollback steps)

Can people ack and call out blockers?

devon: ack. Image built and pushed -> gcr.redwood-inference/release/rc-2026-03-17 sha:sha256:abcd1234. Ran quick staging smoke 20m ago, all green. Migration SQL reviewed, no destructive ops; recommend keeping feature flag off until ramp.

kirby: I can own canary at 21:00. I'll execute smoke via `scripts/smoke_canary.sh --env=canary` and watch dashboards. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback. Ping @mike for rollback trigger path.

ops-bot: CI: canary-smoke-job #7890 succeeded (staging) — summary: 12 tests passed, 0 failed, 3 warnings. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/jobs/7890

sre-jen: ack from SRE. Rollback tag created -> release/rc-2026-03-17-rollback (reverts to sha:sha256:prev123). Alerts tightened: latency/error thresholds set; added quick rollback steps to runbook at /docs/runbooks/deploy_rollback.md. I'll be online for the window.

mike: on-call ack. I'll monitor apdex and traces channel. I can kick the rollback job (`./rollback --tag release/rc-2026-03-17-rollback`) if we hit abort conditions. Reminder: keep 22:00–22:30 as contingency if we need extended work.

amanda: thanks. Quick actions before 21:00: devon, confirm image sha (reply with full sha); kirby, verify smoke script is up-to-date; jen/mike, ensure rollback job permissions are live. I'll post a final GO 5m before window.

devon: full image sha: sha256:abcd1234ef567890. Confirmed registry TTL and tags.

21:00 UTC log: devon: starting canary deploy now -> `./deploy --lane canary --tag release/rc-2026-03-17 --image sha256:abcd1234ef567890`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy finished (canary lane) — health checks OK, 3 replicas healthy.

kirby: canary smoke ran at 21:06 — all smoke tests passed (quick perf within expected range). I'm continuing to monitor for 10m.

amanda: received. Canary green at 21:16 (10m observation). GO to ramp. I'll update the checklist: 
- [x] canary image built and verified
- [x] migration SQL validated on staging
- [x] canary run smoke passed
- [x] runbooks updated

amanda: final notes: ramping now. If anyone sees >2% errors or latency spike >2s for 5m, call rollback immediately and @sre-jen or @mike will execute. Thanks all, please post any post-deploy issues in #eng-releases and tag me.
